excerpts.quote: A widget carries load through the spine and the two flanges. The shroud carries no load and exists to keep debris out of the seat.
The seat is the machined face where the two halves meet. A seat that is not clean will read as misalignment on every subsequent measurement.

sources.title: Widget Fastener Specification WF-7 (synthetic fixture source)

excerpts.quote: An M6 flange bolt is rated to 9 newton metres. Below 7 newton metres the joint loosens under vibration. Above 11 newton metres the flange thread strips.
